headline: Get a $2,500 gaming PC for $1,749 with Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RX 9070 XT
summary: This iBuyPower prebuilt gaming PC is $750 off at Walmart, featuring AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D processor and RX 9070 XT graphics card.
details: The iBuyPower Y40 gaming PC includes an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D processor, RX 9070 XT 16GB graphics card, 32GB of DDR5-5200 memory, and 1TB of storage. This prebuilt desktop retails for $2,500 but is on sale at Walmart for $1,749.

The core specs here are excellent. On the CPU front, the Ryzen 7 9800X3D remains the best CPU for gaming, only outclassed by the overclocked Ryzen 7 9850X3D. And you can make up that difference with a moderate overclock on the base CPU.

Overclocking is possible too thanks to the included 360mm all-in-one liquid cooler. On the GPU front, the RX 9070 XT is the most powerful graphics card AMD currently offers, and it's able to hang at 4K without too many problems.
